explanation: The Mathlib equivalence identifies the localization with the adjoined-root quotient and commutes with the algebra map on every element. Specializing that property to the polynomial generator X (i, j), then using the matrix-entry definition, yields this result. The current proof uses the same equivalence indirectly through quotientEquiv_matrix.
